$comment: Paper-writing skill registry for Claude Code. Consumed by scripts/install-skills.sh.

skills.title: Paper Writing Skill (SNL-UCSB)
skills.summary: Brainstorm -> Draft 0 -> Evaluate -> Write -> Compress pipeline with 18 mechanical + 31 semantic style gates and an independent red-team review pass.
skills.best_for: Systems / networking / ML conference and journal papers; prose discipline and revision.

skills.title: LaTeX Paper Skill (claim ledger + de-AI prose)
skills.summary: Claim ledger tying every assertion to an artifact, citations verified rather than recalled, de-AI prose pass, and a mechanical check after each edit.
skills.best_for: Theses and technical reports where citation integrity and human-sounding prose matter.

skills.title: LaTeX Skill for Computational & Applied Mathematics
skills.summary: Compilable LaTeX for theorems, proofs, convergence analysis, algorithms, TikZ and Beamer. Document / snippet / beamer modes.
skills.best_for: Math-heavy manuscripts and conference talk slides.

skills.title: Academic Research Skills (ARS)
skills.license_note: Non-commercial use only. Not redistributed in this repository; fetched on demand.
skills.summary: Four-skill suite: 13-agent deep research (incl. PRISMA systematic review), 12-agent paper writing pipeline with Markdown/DOCX/LaTeX output, 7-agent mock peer review, and a 10-stage orchestrator.
skills.best_for: End-to-end literature review -> draft -> review -> revision workflows.
skills.reason_external: Skill directories reference ../shared, ../agents and ../scripts, so they need the full repository tree; also CC BY-NC.

skills.title: flonat-research (PhD research infrastructure)
skills.link_note: latex-flonat is renamed from upstream 'latex' to avoid colliding with the vendored latex skill.
skills.summary: Skills, agents, hooks and rules for academic workflows: LaTeX, camera-ready checks, bibliography parsing, proof checking, replication audit, experiment design.
skills.best_for: Standing research infrastructure around a thesis or lab repo.
skills.reason_external: Full infrastructure repo (~23 MB) carrying its own CLAUDE.md, hooks and rules; only a subset is paper-related.

skills.title: Universal LaTeX Document Skill
skills.license_note: No LICENSE file upstream, so no redistribution rights are granted. Clone it yourself; review before use.
skills.summary: 27 templates, 27 scripts and 26 reference guides covering general-purpose LaTeX document production.
skills.best_for: Template breadth beyond papers (reports, letters, CVs, posters).
skills.reason_external: No upstream license; redistribution is not permitted.
